summary: Comprehensive, well-structured test suite covering core requirements (matrix expansion, include/exclude rules, fail-fast, max-parallel, max-size validation, JSON output, GitHub Actions integration). Good coverage of error scenarios and boundary conditions. Uses appropriate Pester patterns with fixtures and caching for expensive act runs. However, gaps exist: no tests for input validation edge cases (numeric axis values, invalid key names, overlapping includes), no verification of fixture contents against expected results, potential brittleness in test setup dependencies (Workflow.Tests relies on successful Invoke-ActHarness execution without defensive error handling). The act harness itself lacks error handling for git/fixture operations. Despite these gaps, the test suite would catch most regressions in core logic and GitHub Actions integration.
